scope: Complete native history through accepted RI120; source-only opaque custody, not runtime capture or execution authority.

retained_base.namespace_rule: All old roles, field IDs, arrays, failure and incident groups resolve only inside this exact immutable base manifest.

opaque_policy: Scientific certificates, candidate/report/stdout/stderr/samples and qualification results are terminal opaque bodies. Publication-only and unrelated worktree metadata are opaque; no RI116 new expansion.
reference_encoding: Each provenance group resolves metadata_role in this manifest and field_ids in reference_field_dictionary. The declared identity consists exactly of declared_identity_keys selected from the target protected-file identity; all declared values were compared exactly. Inherited base-role declarations are qualified by the immutable base manifest and keep its separate dictionary. No declared pin is silently refreshed.
